note: RV park in the hills south of Warsaw, between Truman Lake and Lake of the Ozarks, beside the park's own bar and grill (Cora's Corner, live music on weekends). It sells nightly, monthly and annual sites, and much of the park is long-term. Two catch-and-release ponds. RVs only, no tents. Formerly Benton Ridge Winery and Campground. RV Life unrated. --Claude
summary: Confirmed: $50 nightly full-hookup sites (2-night holiday minimum), reserve by phone or emailed form, open all year, full hookups, laundry, limited Wi-Fi. Google 4.4/34. At the $50 line exactly, no gateway. Passes the five long-stay tests on paper but the imagery and reviews read largely long-term - borderline, reported.
flags: GATE FACTS (private): posted rate $50/night full hook-up (operator's own Google Sites page, current; page carries no date), no tax or fee stated; at the US$50 line, not over it. No gateway within 40 km (nearest Kansas City 141 km). Not a Good Sam Park per the entry; no discount stated. Family has not stayed (no trips reference).

PRESENCE: working operator page (Google Sites) with phone 660-776-9463 and email; Google Maps open, 4.4 stars from 34 reviews, same phone, website = the Google Sites page. No booking engine; reservations by phone or a Google Form ('Site rental form': dates, party, site type Back in/Pull-thru, unit type incl. 'Motorhome (class C)', slide-outs, 'Unit year', e-signature). The form asks unit year but the pages state no age rule.

LONG-STAY (sells monthly from $300 and annual from $1,900, electric billed back; banner 'We currently have 40 acres for rent monthly'; 'Vacant land available for rent 1500 a month'): (1) price $50 = at the line, pass; (2) nightly rate posted on its own site with phone, reservation by a request form with no application/approval/lease stated - pass; (3) only a 2-night holiday minimum - pass; (4) no count of nightly vs long-term sites published - pass by rule; (5) not a home community (rents land, sells no homes or lots) - pass.

SEASONAL CHARACTER (reported for the on-the-fence rule): leaf-off imagery shows roughly 90+ RVs parked on nearly every pad, many with sheds, decks and skirting, which reads as mostly long-term occupancy; the About page courts 'Retirees and Snowbirds - looking for long-term stays' alongside 'RV Travelers - in need of ... overnight or extended-stay sites'. Google reviews read (newest few visible): 'Love camping here, we have a yearly lease and love coming down' (3 months ago); 'We have an RV here and have been very happy' (3 years ago); the rest are about the bar/grill and bands. No review read describes an overnight stay. My reading: borderline - likely mostly long-term, but it posts a nightly rate at $50, has a 4.4 Google rating over 34 reviews, and nothing iffy (no complaints read); AWH to decide.
PIN: stored 38.3155,-93.2951 is among the RV rows south of the office/bar - fine (Google's pin 38.31670,-93.29570 is the bar/office lot, 140 m N).

WATERFRONT: not waterfront kept - the water here is two small catch-and-release ponds (under an acre each on imagery); one sits at the south end of the RV rows, the other in the woods east of the office. Not measured pad by pad; no operator water claim.
Note rewritten: hookups, holiday minimum, year-round, booking method and 'bath house, laundry' removed (fields hold them); added that the park sells monthly/annual and is largely long-term.
